title: If this is an emergency
body: If you have any of these, call 911 or go to the nearest emergency room now: heavy bleeding that soaks a pad in an hour; chest pain or trouble breathing; a seizure; thoughts of hurting yourself or your baby (call or text 988 first if you can). For thoughts of harming yourself, call or text 988 any time. If you are not safe at home, call the National Domestic Violence Hotline: 1-800-799-7233. To reach the practice after hours, call {{after_hours_phone}} (placeholder number in this demo).

title: Warning signs to act on
body: Call the practice, or 911 if it is severe, for any of these: a headache that will not go away or gets worse; dizziness or fainting; changes in your vision; a fever of 100.4 or higher; extreme swelling of your hands or face; thoughts of hurting yourself or others; trouble breathing; chest pain or a fast-beating heart; severe belly pain that does not go away; heavy bleeding or leaking fluid; swelling, redness, or pain in your leg or arm; overwhelming tiredness. This list is a placeholder based on the CDC Hear Her warning signs. The clinical owner has not yet confirmed it.

title: After hours
body: Outside {{coverage_hours}}, call {{after_hours_phone}}. This is a placeholder number in this demo. If this is an emergency, call 911 now.

title: Your named contact
body: {{contact_name}}. Call {{contact_phone}}. Hours: {{coverage_hours}}. After hours, call {{after_hours_phone}}. Practice numbers are placeholders in this demo.

title: Help you can reach now
body: Your answers are saved. As you chose, they are not shared with the practice. If you want to talk with someone now, call or text 988 any time. To reach the practice, call {{contact_phone}}. After hours, call {{after_hours_phone}}. If this is an emergency, call 911 now.

title: We have not reached a nurse yet
body: We have not been able to reach a nurse yet. Do not wait for us. Call {{phone}} now. If this is an emergency, call 911.

title: Help now
body: You can request a call from the practice below. If this cannot wait, call now. Your named contact is {{contact_name}} at {{contact_phone}}. After hours, call {{after_hours_phone}}.

title: Callback needs a connection
body: Your phone is offline, so a callback request cannot be sent right now. Call {{contact_phone}} instead. If this is an emergency, call 911 now.
